ordinary_module_normalization.helper_source:
def module_reference(ordinary):
    """O0 declared process wrapper removal; preserve every other byte."""
    header = b'_start:
  call __init
  .argc r0
  .lea r1, __argvv
  imm r2, 0
__argv_top:
  slt64 r3, r2, r0
  jumpz r3, __argv_done
  .argv r4, r2
  imm r5, 8
  mul64 r5, r2, r5
  add64 r5, r1, r5
  store64 [r5+0], r4
  imm r5, 1
  add64 r2, r2, r5
  jump __argv_top
__argv_done:
  call main
  jump __main_ret
.bss __argvv 32768
'
    assert ordinary.startswith(header) and ordinary.count(header) == 1, 'unexpected startup wrapper'
    body = ordinary[len(header):]
    marker = b'__main_ret:
'
    assert body.count(marker) == 1, 'ambiguous generated return label'
    at = body.index(marker)
    assert body[:at].endswith(b'__init:
  ret
') or (b'__init:
' in body[:at] and body[:at].endswith(b'  ret
')), 'unexpected init return'
    tails = (b'__main_ret:
  .exit r0
', b'__main_ret:
  call exit
  .exit r0
')
    matched = [tail for tail in tails if body[at:].startswith(tail)]
    assert len(matched) == 1, 'unexpected process exit wrapper'
    tail = matched[0]
    return body[:at] + body[at + len(tail):]
ordinary_module_normalization.contract: Delete exactly the leading declared startup and declared __main_ret process exit immediately following init ret; preserve every other byte. Optimise transformed O0 reference for O1/O2, never strip optimized program tape.
